messages:
olivia_ops: @supply_gary quick update — BroadLane just pushed our H100 top-off ETA by 10 days, they also shipped a small replacement batch (12 units) via sea but the manifest has 3 serials that don't match our PO. Need routing decision: accept sea partial, or pay to air-expedite the remaining quantity from vendor stock? :thinking:
supply_gary: Sorry about the bump — vendor says factory thermal test delays. For the mismatched serials they claim a labeling error at the depot, they can overnight corrected AWBs if we pay expedite surcharge (~$5.8k). Sea arrival would be ~14 days and needs customs HS reclass review.
mike_t: Cost note — our budget can absorb up to $4k expedite for this wave; anything above needs approval from finance. If we accept sea, we can pull 6 units from the loaner pool to keep critical jobs running.
kai_sre: Cluster impact — if we lose these 12 units for 2 weeks we hit 25% reduced capacity in ap-southeast staging, job queue latency will spike and autoscaler won't be able to maintain training throughput for two pods. Loaners are fine short-term but not for sustained runs. Recommend air for at least the 6 highest-IOPS SKUs.
sara_p: Logistics check — sea manifest: AWB SEA-BL-77812, container ETA 2026-05-12. If we accept sea we must update customs with HS 8471.90 and pre-file to avoid demurrage. For air: vendor can issue AWB AIR-BL-99123 with corrected serials tomorrow EOD if we approve expedite.
olivia_ops: So options: (A) pay ~$5.8k expedite, get 12 corrected units by next 48h via air; (B) accept sea, pick up loaners (6) + accept 6 less capacity for 2 weeks; (C) hybrid: air-expedite 6 high-IOPS units (~$3.2k) + sea for remainder. Which do we greenlight?
supply_gary: Vendor prefers hybrid — they've reserved outbound freighter seats for 6 units. They can do the 6-air option for ~$3.1k and send the rest by sea. They will also provide corrected serial docs for the sea shipment at no extra charge.
mike_t: Finance can approve up to $3.5k from contingency without exec signoff. So hybrid is OK from finance.
kai_sre: Approve hybrid. We'll schedule critical training onto the 6 air units and move less-urgent queues to loaners and spot instances.
sara_p: I'll pre-file customs for the sea manifest and schedule container hold release to minimize demurrage. Need final ok from OLIVIA to instruct vendor.
olivia_ops: OK — hybrid it is. @supply_gary confirm AWB and pickup window, share tracking when available. @sara_p start customs pre-file and hold release. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
logistics_bot: Reminder created: ticket #RDW-2026-1421 for BroadLane hybrid expedite — ETA actions assigned to sara_p (customs) and supply_gary (AWB).
